latest.title: Asymptotics of holomorphic torsion on orbifolds and an equivariant arithmetic Hilbert-Samuel theorem
latest.abstract: We compute the $\log p$-part of the asymptotic expansion of the holomorphic torsion of the $p$-th power of a positive line bundle in terms of characteristic classes. This is done for orbifold and equivariant torsions. In the equivariant case the exponents in the expansion are less than or equal to the dimension of the fixed point set. We deduce a corresponding equivariant arithmetic Hilbert-Samuel theorem in Arakelov geometry.
latest.workSummary: 计算正线丛高次幂的全纯挠率渐近展开中 log p 部分，覆盖 orbifold 与等变情形，并推出等变算术 Hilbert–Samuel 定理。
latest.breakthrough: 将固定点集维数控制的等变渐近项转化为算术几何结论。
latest.limitations: 只明确计算对数部分；依赖正线丛与相应等变/orbifold 设置，不等同于任意线丛完整渐近展开。
latest.priorityReason: 对解析挠率和 Arakelov 交叉方向有高针对性，课题组一般几何阅读顺位次于曲率与流的主线。
